tei:div.tei:p: gnod sbyin rdo rje bdud 'dul gyi gtor chog /na mo badz+ra dhā ra ya/ gnod sbyin chen po rdo rje bdud 'dul gyi mchod gtor tshul bzhin du bshams la/ bsang sbyang gis byin gyis brlab pa sngon du byas nas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la k+ṣa yig las byung ba'i gnod sbyin chen po rdo rje bdud 'dul sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas dgos 'dod stsol ba'i nor bu rin po che dang*/ g.yon bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bsnams pa/ brjid bag dang bcas pa'i sku la dar nag gi ber chen gsol zhing rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ sgeg cing dpa' ba'i nyams kyis srin po pho mo'i gdan la rgyal po chen po'i rol pas gnas pa'i g.yon na yum gnod sbyin kun 'grub mas 'dud pa/ de nyid kyi shar du dzam la dkar po/ lhor mgon po nag po/ nub tu 'brog gnas mched lnga/ byang du rnam thos sras sogs mdzes shing brjid chags pa'i 'khor grangs med pas bskor ba/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas gnod sbyin chen po 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs par bsam la/ rol mo dbyangs dang bcas pas/ hūm̐/ ri rgyal lhun po'i pha rol na// gnya' shing 'dzin gyi tshur rol na// rin chen mdzes pa'i gzhal yas khang*// bai ḍūr sngon po'i khri steng na// gnod sbyin sde dpon mthu bo che// btsun mo blon por bcas pa rnams// sngon gyi zhal bzhes dam bcas ltar// 'dir gshegs mthun pa'i gdan la bzhugs// e h+ye hi ma hā yak+ṣa rat+na tsit+ta dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ

zhes pas spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na tsit+ta mā le hūm̐ gis cod pan gyi dbang bskur/ rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru// bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa'i// bdud 'dul mthu chen gter gyi bdag /'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ badz+ra dun+ti swā hā a ti pū ho/ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ zhes phyag bya/ hūm̐/ mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa la// spos dang mar me me tog phreng*// tshim pa'i zhal zas snyan pa'i sgra// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya sogs// 'bul gyis bzhes nas dngos grub stsol// oṃ ma hā yak+ṣa sa pa ri wā ra puṣ+pe nas shab+da'i bar dang a mṛta pū dza khā hi/ rak+ta pū dza khā hi/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na tsit+ta rā ga rā ge hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā sa pa ri wā ra gu h+ya ba liṃ ta khā hi/ zhes pas gtor ma 'bul/ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ mgon po rdo rje bdud 'dul ni// thugs rje'i stobs kyis gdug pa 'dul// gzhon nu dpa' bo khros pa'i sku/ khro bo'i rgyal la phyag 'tshal bstod// mgon po g.yul las rnam rgyal te// mgon po rin chen brtsegs par bzhugs// phyag na rin chen thod khrag bsnams// mgon po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// mgon po'i rgyal po dbu mtha' yas// spyan gsum pa la mche ba gtsigs// hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyi 'jigs drag pos// ma rungs 'dul khyod la phyag 'tshal// phyag na mtshon cha sna tshogs bsnams// sbrul dang thod pa'i phreng bas brgyan// dar nag ral ga sku la gsol// rdo rje bdud 'dul khyod la bstod// 'khor ni gnod sbyin stong sdes bskor// mdog nag bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar// rngams pa'i stobs kyis bgegs 'dul ba'i// bgegs 'dul khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i sku la 'phags// mthu rtsal mi mnyam mnga' ba las// srid pa gsum gyi mthar phyin mdzad// bdud 'dul 'jigs byed khyod la bstod// hūm̐/

dbus kyi gru gsum mthing nag na// rdo rje nor bu dngos grub can// klu yi tsha bo zhe brnag can// bstan pa bsrung ba'i dam tshig can// dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i mthu stobs can// 'jigs pa'i skur ston khyod la bstod// sde dpon chen po khyod la bstod// rin chen gter bdag khyod la bstod// bstan pa srung mdzad khyod la bstod// ces bstod cing 'dod don gsol la rjes kyi cho ga rnams gzhan dang thun mong du bya'o// zhes pa 'di'ang 'gyur med rdo rjes yi ge rnying pa rnams kyi legs cha bsdus te brjod bde ba gtso bor byas nas bris pa'o/// /
